messages:
alex: Quick ping — opened PR #1427 changing helper fn names and small reformat. Need one approval & a lint pass. Link: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/inference/pull/1427
maya: skimmed — looks fine but there's a style nit: snake_case for helpers (format_user_id) vs camelCase. Can you add a small migration comment?
taylor: also saw CI failing on line-length in tests. Prettier bumped some strings. Can you re-run format? `make format` or `pre-commit run --all-files`
alex: yep will run format. also updated the docstring. here's the core diff:
```diff
- def formatUserID(id):
-     return "user-" + str(id)
+ def format_user_id(id):
+     return f"user-{id}"
```
chris: friendly reminder — merge window tomorrow afternoon. if we get approvals, I'll queue it. also assign a reviewer from eng oncall.
maya: tiny nit: update imports in `utils/__init__.py` — exports need `format_user_id` instead of old name.
ci-bot: build failed — flake8: E302 expected 2 blank lines, file utils/ids.py:15
alex: fixed blank lines and pushed. CI triggered.
ci-bot: build passed — all checks green ✅
chris: +1 from me once green, merge after smoke tests in canary.
alex: thanks all, assigned taylor as reviewer and will merge after canary.
